title.zh: 沙箱 + execpolicy 完整决策流

description.zh: 模拟 Codex 对 shell 命令的完整安全决策：execpolicy 规则引擎（prefix_rule / BANNED_PREFIX_SUGGESTIONS）→ 启发式回退（is_known_safe_command / command_might_be_dangerous）→ Decision（Allow/Prompt/Forbidden）→ SandboxManager 选择隔离后端。对应 core/src/exec_policy.rs + sandboxing/src/manager.rs。
description.en: Simulate Codex full security decision for shell commands: execpolicy rule engine → heuristic fallback → Decision (Allow/Prompt/Forbidden) → SandboxManager picks isolation backend. Maps to core/src/exec_policy.rs + sandboxing/src/manager.rs.

steps.content: 帮我检查项目是否编译通过

annotation.zh: 用户请求触发 shell 工具调用，ShellHandler 将命令传给 exec_policy 决策管线
annotation.en: User request triggers shell tool call; ShellHandler passes command to exec_policy decision pipeline

annotation.zh: exec_policy.rs — commands_for_exec_policy() 解析命令，先走 execpolicy 规则引擎，无匹配则进入启发式
annotation.en: exec_policy.rs — commands_for_exec_policy() parses command, tries rule engine first, falls back to heuristics on no match
is_known_safe=false, is_dangerous=false, AskForApproval::OnFailure → Allow. Sandbox enforces actual restrictions

annotation.zh: sandboxing/src/manager.rs — select_initial() 决定使用平台沙箱，transform() 构建 codex-linux-sandbox 的实际 argv
annotation.en: sandboxing/src/manager.rs — select_initial() decides platform sandbox, transform() builds actual argv for codex-linux-sandbox

annotation.zh: Decision::Allow → 命令在 LinuxSeccomp 沙箱内执行。沙箱限制：只能写 workspace 目录，网络受限
annotation.en: Decision::Allow → command executes inside LinuxSeccomp sandbox. Restrictions: write-only to workspace, network restricted

annotation.zh: 模型决定调用 git push，触发新一轮 exec_policy 检查
annotation.en: Model decides to call git push, triggering new exec_policy check

annotation.zh: git 在 BANNED_PREFIX_SUGGESTIONS 中，git push 属于不可逆远端操作 → Decision::Prompt，等待用户批准
annotation.en: git in BANNED_PREFIX_SUGGESTIONS, git push is irreversible remote op → Decision::Prompt, awaiting user approval

annotation.zh: Prompt 触发 approval 流程。proposed_amendment 允许用户将此规则加入 execpolicy rules 文件（exec_policy.rs:try_derive_execpolicy_amendment_for_prompt_rules）
annotation.en: Prompt triggers approval flow. proposed_amendment lets user add rule to execpolicy rules file (exec_policy.rs:try_derive_execpolicy_amendment_for_prompt_rules)

annotation.zh: exec_policy.rs:blocking_append_allow_prefix_rule() — 将 prefix_rule 追加写入 rules/default.rules，实现永久记住批准
annotation.en: exec_policy.rs:blocking_append_allow_prefix_rule() — appends prefix_rule to rules/default.rules for permanent allow

annotation.zh: 用户批准后 Decision → Allow，命令在沙箱内执行
annotation.en: After user approval Decision → Allow, command executes inside sandbox
